records.title: UniFusion: Vision-Language Model as Unified Encoder in Image Generation
records.reason: UniFusion uses a frozen vision-language encoder to condition image diffusion; it does not optimize LLM inference compute, memory, latency, throughput, quantization, offload, or serving.

records.title: Cutting the Skip: Training Residual-Free Transformers
records.reason: The paper studies initialization for training residual-free vision Transformers; its reported objective is training stability/representation learning, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Statistical Advantage of Softmax Attention: Insights from Single-Location Regression
records.reason: This is a statistical theory of softmax attention on a single-location regression task; it presents no inference optimization method or deployment measurement.

records.title: RoboSSM: Scalable In-context Imitation Learning via State-Space Models
records.reason: Weak SSM/long-context transfer from an LLM-adjacent lineage, but evaluated solely for robot policies.

records.title: FLARE: Fast Low-rank Attention Routing Engine
records.reason: Plausible efficient-attention connection to Nyströmformer, but no LLM result; retain as borderline pending decoder validation.
